semantics.clock: Positive edge clk, as stated in final sentence of problem.txt
semantics.reset: Asynchronous active-high areset sets q to zero; evidence: asynchronous positive edge triggered areset and item (1)
semantics.priority: areset > load > ena > hold; evidence: items (1)-(3) and explicit load-over-ena priority
semantics.load: At positive clock edge with reset low and load high, q becomes data[3:0]
semantics.shift: At positive clock edge with reset and load low and ena high, q becomes floor(unsigned q / 2), inserting zero at bit 3
semantics.hold: No load or enable: retain register contents
semantics.initialization: No power-up initialization is specified; do not initialize DUT; known values established by reset or load
semantics.latency: q updates on the same triggering event, observed after NBA; no added cycles

numeric.arithmetic: No rounding, saturation, or signed arithmetic

verification.oracle: Derived independently from original problem.txt using unsigned integer divide by two
verification.sampling: Drive controls on negative edges; check before next positive edge and after NBA delay; assert reset away from clock edges
coverage: All 16 data values and all four load/ena combinations from each starting value
Four shifts flush all bits, followed by additional zero shifts
Asynchronous reset between clock edges, reset priority over controls, reset held through clock edges, deassertion without clock update
Control/data changes and falling clock edges do not alter q
